title: 第623章 夜洐不来第622章 最强天骄对决要出现了
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
龙舟凤宫停下，包括随行的众人，纷纷停下脚步，停在生死轮回殿地界边界处。
无人再继续向前。
此地距离生死轮回殿的圣地禁区，尚有数百里之遥，谁都清楚，此行不可能真的嚣张闯入圣地禁区，祖庭圣地威严不容轻犯。
能堵在地界大门处，已是表面态度。
“这般阵仗，生死轮回殿不可能不知晓，为何魔尊厉邪姒还未现身？”
“急什么，她早晚会现身。”
“此时我最好奇，夜洐此子究竟会不会出面？”
对于厉邪姒现身与否，无多少人疑惑。
以她魔尊的身份，魔尊的傲气，加上此时局势，绝无避战退缩的道理，有些对战，纵使不敌，也万万不能后退，一旦退让躲避，她身后整个生死轮回殿数万年的威名，何在？
但夜洐不同，他孑然一身，无宗门羁绊、无圣地枷锁，身后半分体面无需维护。
“放心好了，夜洐本人就算不想出面，但生死轮回殿会逼着他出来。”
“他承受轮回殿如此多恩情，不得不出来。”
比起厉邪姒与夜洐何时出现。
众人更在意，战斗胜负。
“魔尊厉邪姒底蕴虽深，深不可测，但如今应该不及那位长公主殿下。”
“这些年厉邪姒沉溺情爱、自甘堕落，修行定当荒废，反观长公主殿下，境界已凌驾尊者之上，踏出教主境半步，孰强孰弱，一目了然。”
“长公主殿下亲临此地，必然有必胜把握。”
“只要莫问天能够拿下夜洐，此战之后，妖魔短时间再无嚣张的资本。”
众人显然，更担心莫问天能不能赢。
龙舟凤宫远处，魔气妖力滔天，黑幕垂落遮掩郎朗天日，无数妖魔强者矗立云海，黑压压一片，今日妖魔各方势力强者也来了不少。

此时也在讨论战斗胜负。
“两场对决，只要赢一场便不算失败。”
“只能看夜洐能不能赢了。”
帝袍女子主动放弃突破教主境，这一情况天下皆知，看好厉邪姒今日能赢的强者，几乎没几位，但看到夜洐能赢的人不少。
与外界喧嚣嘈杂的观战氛围截然不同，生死轮回殿殿内，气氛凝重如冰封万古，沉沉煞气萦绕不散，压得人喘不过气。
“姑姑，夜洐那家伙，当真不会来？”
这已经厉自在不知第几次问出相同的问题。
此刻厉自在很生气。
从古至今，向来只有他去堵门，去嚣张挑衅他人的资格，何曾被人找上门来堵门挑衅。
岂不是让天下看生死轮回殿的笑话，那就是看我厉自在的笑话。
不能忍。
本尊已经一退再退，这一次没找你莫问天的麻烦，都退到老家来了，你莫问天居然跟随别人登门挑衅，简直不把本尊放在眼中。
厉自在现在比谁都希望，夜洐赶快到来，替他好好教训教训一番该死的莫问天。
因此，他比谁都紧张，夜洐会不会来的结果。
content_en:
The dragon boat and phoenix palace stopped, including everyone accompanying them, and stopped at the boundary of the reincarnation hall of life and death.
No one moved forward.
This place is still hundreds of miles away from the restricted area of ​​the Holy Land of the Reincarnation Hall of Life and Death. Everyone knows that it is impossible to break into the restricted area of ​​the Holy Land in this trip. The majesty of the Holy Land of the Ancestral Court does not tolerate minor violations.
Being able to block the gate of the land is just a superficial attitude.
"It's impossible that the Palace of Reincarnation of Life and Death doesn't know about such a battle. Why hasn't Demon Lord Li Xiesi appeared yet?"
"What's the rush? She will show up sooner or later."
"I'm most curious at this time, will Ye Hui show up?"
Not many people were doubtful as to whether Li Xiesi appeared or not.
With her status as the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord's arrogance, and the situation at this time, there is absolutely no reason to retreat from the battle. In some battles, even if she is defeated, she must not retreat. Once she retreats, where will the tens of thousands of years of prestige of the entire Palace of Life and Death behind her be?
But Ye Hui was different. He was alone, without the fetters of the sect or the shackles of the Holy Land, and he did not need to maintain half of his dignity behind him.
"Don't worry, even if Ye Hui himself doesn't want to come forward, the Reincarnation Palace will force him to come out."
"He has endured so much kindness from the Reincarnation Palace and has no choice but to come out."
Compared to when Li Xiesi and Ye Hui appeared.
Everyone cares more about the outcome of the battle.
"Although Demon Lord Li Xiesi's background is deep and unfathomable, it should not be as good as that of the eldest princess now."
"Over the years, Li Xiesi has indulged in love and fallen into self-indulgence, and her practice will definitely be in ruins. On the other hand, Her Royal Highness, the eldest princess, has reached a level higher than that of the venerable one. She has only taken half a step beyond the realm of the leader. It is clear at a glance who is strong and who is weak."
"Her Royal Highness the Princess is here in person, so she must be sure of victory."
"As long as Mo Wentian can capture Ye Hui, after this battle, the demon will no longer have the capital to be arrogant in a short time."
Everyone was obviously more worried about whether Mo Wentian could win.
In the distance of Dragon Boat Phoenix Palace, the demonic power is overwhelming. The black curtain falls to cover the bright sky. Countless demons and strong men stand in the sea of ​​clouds, and the darkness is overwhelming. Today, many powerful demons and demons have come.
The outcome of the battle was also being discussed at this time.
"Two duels, as long as you win one, it will not be considered a defeat."
"We can only see if Ye Zhi can win."
The woman in imperial robes voluntarily gave up on breaking through to the leader realm. This situation was known to the whole world. There were few strong people who were optimistic that Li Xiesi could win today, but there were many people who saw that Ye Hui could win.
Completely different from the noisy and noisy atmosphere of watching the battle outside, the atmosphere in the Palace of Life and Death was as solemn as if frozen for eternity, and the heavy evil spirit lingered, making people breathless.
"Auntie, do you really think that guy Ye Hao won't come?"
This was the first time Li Zizai had asked the same question.
Li Zizai was very angry at this moment.
From ancient times to the present, he has always been the only one who has the qualifications to block doors and provoke others arrogantly. He has never been approached to block doors and provoke others.
Isn’t it just a joke for the world to see the Palace of Reincarnation of Life and Death? It’s a joke for me, Li Zizai.
Can't bear it.
I have retreated again and again. This time I didn’t cause any trouble for you, Mo Wentian, and I retreated to my hometown. You, Mo Wentian, actually followed others to come to provoke me. You simply don’t take me seriously.
Li Zizai hopes more than anyone else now that Ye Hui will come as soon as possible and teach damn Mo Wentian a lesson for him.
Therefore, he was more nervous than anyone else about whether Ye Zhi would come.
